chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him) concerning the condemnation of the disobedient among his companions.

key_terms.أَصْحَابِهِ: His companions (specifically referring to the companions of Imam Ali)
key_terms.الْعَاصِينَ: The disobedient (those who rebel or fail to obey)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his disobedient companions?
ai.summary: This introductory phrase from Sharif al-Radi’s *Nahj al-Balagha* sets the stage for Imam Ali’s (AS) critique of the *Munafiqun* (hypocrites) and early dissenters within his own ranks, particularly during the turbulent period of the Battle of the Camel. It highlights the scholarly emphasis on distinguishing between sincere followers and those who outwardly pledged allegiance but internally resisted his divine authority and political leadership.
